name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina Volkov brings over two decades of financial expertise to Mitsubishi Motorsport. Graduating with honors from the Moscow State University of Economics, Irina started her career in corporate finance before transitioning to motorsport, driven by a lifelong passion for racing. Her keen eye for detail and relentless pursuit of efficiency have consistently delivered substantial cost savings and improved financial forecasting for previous teams. 

At Mitsubishi Motorsport, Irina is responsible for overseeing all financial operations, including budgeting, reporting, and compliance. She is known for her rigorous approach to financial management and her ability to identify opportunities for optimization. Irina demands accuracy and transparency in all financial matters, ensuring the team operates within a fiscally responsible framework, enabling maximum investment in performance. Her commitment to excellence is what sets her apart.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a practical bob
physical.description: Irina is a woman of average height, with a serious, focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus for quick calculations.
Insists on double-checking all expense reports personally.
Has a collection of miniature race cars on her desk.
